title: Small circumference in regular sublinear expanders
summary: Sublinear expansion is weak enough to be extracted from arbitrary graphs while retaining nearly all of their average degree, yet it has proved strong enough to force global structures in many sparse extremal problems. Letzter, Methuku and Sudakov [JLMS 2026] proved the existence of nearly Hamilton cycles in sufficiently dense regular sublinear expanders. Montgomery [ICM 2026] subsequently conjectured that, every $d$-regular sublinear expander with $d$ sufficiently large (but constant) is Hamiltonian.
